name: pam_listfile
description: Deny access based on file contents (user/host/tty lists)
detailed_description: Access control module that allows or denies access based on whether users, hosts, or terminal names appear in a specified file. Provides flexible list-based access control. Can be configured to allow or deny based on inclusion/exclusion in the list.

parameters.sense: Allow or deny based on list (allow=1 or deny=0)
parameters.file: Path to file containing list entries
parameters.apply: Apply to all entries or specific UID range

notes:
Provides flexible list-based access control based on file contents. Can control access by user, host, TTY, or shell.
